title: Have you had ...?
description: A picture lesson on the present perfect with 'already' and 'just'. Students listen to a recording and answer a question, then study twenty numbered pictures (1,000-20,000) showing foods and drinks: fruit, bananas, oranges, peaches, apples, vegetables, lettuce, cabbage, peas, beans, meat, beef, lamb, steak, chicken, milk, tea, coffee, wine and beer. Written exercises ask students to answer offers using 'I've already had some / one' and to answer questions using 'I haven't had any ... . I've just had some ...'. Workbook practice asks students to reply to offers (yes or no) and to complete two situation dialogues. Grammar exercises ask students to answer 'much/many' questions with 'a lot of' / 'any ... at all', and to give correct replies to 'Let's have ... now' suggestions using 'But I've already had ...'.
answer_note: Lesson listening question is a suggested model answer based on the pictures. Written A (responses using some/one) items 1-2 are printed examples; items 3-9 are suggested model answers following the printed pattern. Written B (answer the questions) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-11 are suggested model answers following the printed pattern. Practice A (I've already had ... / I've just had ...) items 1-2 are printed examples; items 3-12 are taken from the workbook key (img/key-080-085.jpg, Lesson 84 A). Practice B (situations) 2 items are taken from the workbook key (img/key-080-085.jpg, Lesson 84 B). Grammar I (answer the questions according to the examples) items 1.a and 2.a are printed examples; items 1.b-1.h and 2.b-2.h are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer pages 514-515). Grammar II (give correct replies) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-10 are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer pages 514-515). No external sources were used.

lesson.text:
Listen and answer the questions.
听录音并回答问题。
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording and answer the questions.

lesson.title: Listening — answer the question
lesson.instruction: Listen and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。
lesson.translation: Answer the question according to the recording.

questions.prompt: What have you had for lunch today?
questions.answer: I've just had some meat and vegetables for lunch.

lesson.title: Written A — Write responses using some or one
lesson.instruction:
A Write responses using some or one. 模仿例句写出对应的回答，选用 some 或 one。
Examples: Have some coffee. → I've already had some. / Have a banana. → I've already had one.
lesson.translation: Write a response to each offer, using 'I've already had some' (uncountable) or 'I've already had one' (countable), following the examples.

questions.prompt: Example: Have some coffee.
questions.answer: I've already had some.

questions.prompt: Example: Have a banana.
questions.answer: I've already had one.

questions.prompt: Have some beer.
questions.answer: I've already had some.

questions.prompt: Have an apple.
questions.answer: I've already had one.

questions.prompt: Have a peach.
questions.answer: I've already had one.

questions.prompt: Have some milk.
questions.answer: I've already had some.

questions.prompt: Have a glass of water.
questions.answer: I've already had one.

questions.prompt: Have a biscuit.
questions.answer: I've already had one.

questions.prompt: Have some cheese.
questions.answer: I've already had some.

lesson.title: Written B — Answer these questions
lesson.instruction:
B Answer these questions. 模仿例句回答以下问题。
Example: Have you had any vegetables or fruit? (I) → I haven't had any vegetables. I've just had some fruit.
lesson.translation: Answer each question in the first person indicated, saying you haven't had one thing but have just had the other, following the example.

questions.prompt: Example: Have you had any vegetables or fruit? (I)
questions.answer: I haven't had any vegetables. I've just had some fruit.

questions.prompt: Has he had any beans or peas? (He)
questions.answer: He hasn't had any beans. He's just had some peas.

questions.prompt: Have they had any tea or coffee? (They)
questions.answer: They haven't had any tea. They've just had some coffee.

questions.prompt: Have you had any apples or peaches? (I)
questions.answer: I haven't had any apples. I've just had some peaches.

questions.prompt: Have you had any cabbage or lettuce? (I)
questions.answer: I haven't had any cabbage. I've just had some lettuce.

questions.prompt: Has she had any beer or wine? (She)
questions.answer: She hasn't had any beer. She's just had some wine.

questions.prompt: Has he had any lamb or beef? (He)
questions.answer: He hasn't had any lamb. He's just had some beef.

questions.prompt: Have they had any tea or milk? (They)
questions.answer: They haven't had any tea. They've just had some milk.

questions.prompt: Has she had any meat or vegetables? (She)
questions.answer: She hasn't had any meat. She's just had some vegetables.

questions.prompt: Have you had any chicken or steak? (I)
questions.answer: I haven't had any chicken. I've just had some steak.

questions.prompt: Have they had any bananas or oranges? (They)
questions.answer: They haven't had any bananas. They've just had some oranges.

practice.title: A — I've already had ... / I've just had ...
practice.instruction: Write answers to these offers, like the examples. (✓) = yes, and (✗) = no. 根据括号中的提示对以下提议作出应答。
practice.translation: Reply to each offer. For (✓) accept the offer ('That's very kind. Thank you very much.'); for (✗) refuse with 'No, thank you. I've just had one/some.', following the examples.
practice.context: Items 1-2 are printed examples. Items 3-12 are taken from the workbook key (img/key-080-085.jpg, Lesson 84 A).

questions.prompt: 1. Have some wine. (✓)
questions.answer: Some wine? That's very kind. Thank you very much.

questions.prompt: 2. Have an orange. (✗)
questions.answer: An orange? No, thank you. I've just had one.

questions.prompt: 3. Have a cup of coffee. (✓)
questions.answer: A cup of coffee? That's very kind. Thank you very much.

questions.prompt: 4. Have some biscuits. (✗)
questions.answer: Some biscuits? No, thank you. I've just had some.

questions.prompt: 5. Have a glass of beer. (✗)
questions.answer: A glass of beer? No, thank you. I've just had one.

questions.prompt: 6. Have lunch with us. (✓)
questions.answer: Lunch with you? That's very kind. Thank you very much.

questions.prompt: 7. Have a cake. (✗)
questions.answer: A cake? No, thank you. I've just had one.

questions.prompt: 8. Have some honey on your bread. (✗)
questions.answer: Some honey on my bread? No, thank you. I've just had some.

questions.prompt: 9. Have some potatoes. (✗)
questions.answer: Some potatoes? No, thank you. I've just had some.

questions.prompt: 10. Have a glass of water. (✓)
questions.answer: A glass of water? That's very kind. Thank you very much.

questions.prompt: 11. Have an ice cream. (✗)
questions.answer: An ice cream? No, thank you. I've just had one.

questions.prompt: 12. Have some cheese. (✗)
questions.answer: Some cheese? No, thank you. I've just had some.

practice.title: B — Situations
practice.instruction: Read each situation carefully. What do you say? 根据以下情景写出你可能会说的话。
practice.translation: Read each situation and write what you would say.
practice.context: Both items are taken from the workbook key (img/key-080-085.jpg, Lesson 84 B).

questions.prompt: 1. Two friends visit you. How do you suggest that you all go into the living room?
questions.answer: Let's go into the living room.

questions.prompt: 2. You take a friend into your room. There are clothes, books, magazines, etc. everywhere. How do you apologize?
questions.answer: Excuse the mess.

grammar.source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=255
grammar.title: I — Answer the questions according to the examples
grammar.instruction: I. Answer the questions according to the examples. 仿照例句回答下列问题。
grammar.translation: Answer each yes/no question in the affirmative with 'a lot of' (following example 1.a) or in the negative with 'any ... at all' (following example 2.a).
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=515
grammar.context: Items 1.a and 2.a are printed examples. Items 1.b-1.h and 2.b-2.h are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 515).

questions.prompt: 1. a. Have you had much beer?
questions.answer: Yes, I have. I have just had a lot of beer.

questions.prompt: 1. b. Has she had many vegetables?
questions.answer: Yes, she has. She has just had a lot of vegetables.

questions.prompt: 1. c. Have they had many bananas?
questions.answer: Yes, they have. They have just had a lot of bananas.

questions.prompt: 1. d. Has he had many cakes?
questions.answer: Yes, he has. He has just had a lot of cakes.

questions.prompt: 1. e. Has she had much milk?
questions.answer: Yes, she has. She has just had a lot of milk.

questions.prompt: 1. f. Have you had much coffee?
questions.answer: Yes, I/we have. I/We have just had a lot of coffee.

questions.prompt: 1. g. Have they had much fruit?
questions.answer: Yes, they have. They have just had a lot of fruit.

questions.prompt: 1. h. Has he had much medicine?
questions.answer: Yes, he has. He has just had a lot of medicine.

questions.prompt: 2. a. Have you had much coffee?
questions.answer: No, we haven't. We haven't had any coffee at all.

questions.prompt: 2. b. Have they had many cakes?
questions.answer: No, they haven't. They haven't had any cakes at all.

questions.prompt: 2. c. Has he had much wine?
questions.answer: No, he hasn't. He hasn't had any wine at all.

questions.prompt: 2. d. Has she had much milk?
questions.answer: No, she hasn't. She hasn't had any milk at all.

questions.prompt: 2. e. Have you had much steak?
questions.answer: No, I/we haven't. I/We haven't had any steak at all.

questions.prompt: 2. f. Have they had much beef?
questions.answer: No, they haven't. They haven't had any beef at all.

questions.prompt: 2. g. Has he had many aspirins?
questions.answer: No, he hasn't. He hasn't had any aspirins at all.

questions.prompt: 2. h. Have you had much water?
questions.answer: No, I/we haven't. I/We haven't had any water at all.

grammar.title: II — Give correct replies to the sentences given
grammar.instruction: II. Give correct replies to the sentences given according to the example. 仿照例句写出下列各句的对应句。
grammar.translation: Give the correct reply to each 'Let's have ... now' suggestion, following the example.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=515
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example. Items 2-10 are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 515).

questions.prompt: 1. Let's have dinner now.
questions.answer: But I've already had dinner.

questions.prompt: 2. Let's have some fruit now.
questions.answer: But I've already had some fruit.

questions.prompt: 3. Let's have some tea now.
questions.answer: But I've already had some tea.

questions.prompt: 4. Let's have some apples now.
questions.answer: But I've already had some apples.

questions.prompt: 5. Let's have lunch now.
questions.answer: But I've already had lunch.

questions.prompt: 6. Let's have a cup of coffee now.
questions.answer: But I've already had a cup of coffee.

questions.prompt: 7. Let's have some roast beef now.
questions.answer: But I've already had some roast beef.

questions.prompt: 8. Let's have a drink now.
questions.answer: But I've already had a drink.

questions.prompt: 9. Let's have a swim now.
questions.answer: But I've already had a swim.

questions.prompt: 10. Let's have some whisky now.
questions.answer: But I've already had some whisky.
